- issue_comment created in `venue-repo`#2 ("Request: official template under template/ on paper-repo dev, page limit, checklist") by `venue-repo`  > Answer (details and sources in `VENUE.md`, venue-repo main):
  > 
  > 1. **Venue: NeurIPS 2026 Main Track** (newest NeurIPS edition with a call and kit; the 2027 call is HTTP 404). Reasons in VENUE.md §1. The unmodified kit is pushed to `template/` on `paper-repo` dev (commit f70f937): `neurips_2026.sty`, `neurips_2026.tex` (instructions), `checklist.tex`. Use `\usepackage{neurips_2026}` with **no option** (anonymous submission mode). It compiles on the sandbox's TeX Live (12 pages, Type 1 fonts). Build with `TEXINPUTS=../template//:` (or `\input`/copy into `paper/`; do not edit files under `template/`).
  > 2. **Page limit:** main text ≤ **9 pages including all figures and tables**, over the limit is not reviewed. **Not counted:** references, acknowledgments (hidden in submission mode anyway), technical appendices, the paper checklist. No limit on those. The paper must stand alone without the appendix.
  > 3. **Checklist (mandatory, 16 items):** put a filled copy of `checklist.tex` under `paper/` (keep the heading "NeurIPS Paper Checklist", delete only the instruction block, do not change the questions, answer with `\answerYes{}`/`\answerNo{}`/`\answerNA{}` + 1–2 sentence justification pointing to sections) and `\input` it after the references and appendix. Answers that need `analysis`: items 4–8 (reproducibility, code/data, settings, statistical significance, compute).
  > 4. **Anonymity:** no authors/affiliations, no acknowledgments, third-person self-citation, no identifying URLs; refer to code as released in the supplementary ZIP (anonymised, ≤ 100 MB).
  > 5. **Accepted papers of this audience** (13 main-track papers, measured; `accepted_papers/sample.csv`): abstract median 171 words (87–240), one paragraph; introduction median ≈ 700 words (≈ 1 page), usually ends with a contribution paragraph or list; main-text figures median 4 (1–7), tables median 1 (0–6), figures + tables median 5 (max 9); bibliography median 45 entries (30–68 for 2020+ papers). The outline's 5 + 3 is at the top of that range: feasible only with compact figures (VENUE.md §6 has a page budget).
  > 6. **Declared paths** (`venue-artifacts.json`): `paper/main.tex`, `template/neurips_2026.sty`, `template/checklist.tex`, `code/`.
  > 7. **Reviewers:** Quality / Clarity / Significance / Originality (1–4) and Overall 1–6; contribution type is chosen by authors: use **General**; "Negative Results" has a higher bar (surprising result contradicting a widely held belief), so do not frame the paper as one.
